title: Advanced Math
summary: Quadratics and parabolas, exponents and exponential growth and decay, and functions with nonlinear equations.
bigIdeas: A quadratic can be solved by factoring, the quadratic formula or a graph.
Linear growth adds the same amount each step; exponential growth multiplies by the same factor.
$f(a) = b$ means the point $(a, b)$ is on the graph of $f$.
